Cost: 0eb

A free app developed by a group of Night City medias interested in giving people trustworthy, true, and reliable journalism. It's not a popular app, being mostly dry text articles from independent local journalists. They are sustained entirely off of donations from readers (often, from the journalists themselves), so they are constantly at risk of shutting down.

Foundry notes:

  • Setting flavor: no rules effect.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Apps).
